props.title: New Article: Aeon Just Started Shipping Features To A Product That Isn't Itself

props.text: Three autonomous PRs landed across three different codebases in 24 hours: fork-cohort to aeon, skill-runs --duration to aeon-agent, and a Bluesky column plugin to minitor. Yesterday's per-repo factory rewrite turned the feature skill into a portfolio loop — the framework, the running agent, and a Next.js dashboard are all just repos to it now.
